_comment: EMPTY, and kept rather than deleted. Bean hrv2 opened this file on 2026-09-21 with four entries -- prose in skills naming `harness.json` as the declaration filename -- and bean vzur emptied it the same day by fixing them. The mechanism is the record: a NEW contradiction fails, a listed one is reported every run, and an entry that stops matching is reported STALE and fails too, so the file shrinks rather than fossilises. All four were reported stale and removed here, which is what that rule looks like when it works. The file stays so the next backlog entry has somewhere to go and so the shrink is visible in history; removing a durable artefact is not an agent's call to make on its own initiative (`deletion-requires-confirmation`).
